## Review Focus

- [ ] The change is scoped to the stated Forward Auth regression, site, or workflow goal.
- [ ] AI-authored changes were reviewed by an engineer before push.
- [ ] The PR description explains the failure classification or implementation reason.
- [ ] Test isolation, deterministic execution, and data ownership were considered where relevant.

## Local Validation

- [ ] `npm run prepush:check` passed locally, or the exception is explained below.
- [ ] No `.env`, secrets, logs, `dist`, or generated build artifacts were committed.
- [ ] The branch was checked against `origin/main` for stale commits and likely merge conflicts.

## GitHub Validation

- [ ] CI completed successfully.
- [ ] Review comments were resolved.
- [ ] Branch protection requirements are satisfied before merge.

## Notes for Reviewers

Call out risky areas, skipped checks, known flaky behavior, or any reason this should stay draft.
